Cricket Analyst Suggests Team Changes for Japan Match

Cricket analyst Akash Chopra has suggested two changes to the Indian team for their upcoming match against Japan. Chopra recommended resting Abhishek Sharma and playing Vaibhav Suryavanshi instead. Separately, Jayasurya responded to critics targeting Gautam Gambhir, advising against rushing Vaibhav Suryavanshi.
